# Guest pack

For the evaluator with no account and no key yet: everything on this page is checkable from where you stand.

## What this is

AxiomCode is a certification authority for software correctness: it checks Lean 4 artefacts with a real toolchain and issues signed, revocable certificates. Start with the claim and its bounds — [what verification proves](/docs/explanation/what-verification-proves/) and [what it does not prove](/docs/explanation/what-it-does-not-prove/) — before the marketing.

## Judge it without an account

- [Status](/status/) — every surface, including paused and not-built ones, from the canonical source.

- [Practice](/practice/) — how releases are gated and soaked, and the assurance limits, stated plainly (including: no external audit has been performed).

- [Changelog](/changelog/) — the append-only record, findings and incidents included.

- [Certificate checker](/check/) — if anyone hands you a certificate, check it in your browser; no account needed.

## Try it

The trial needs a key, and keys are free by email ([hello@axiom-code.com](mailto:hello@axiom-code.com?subject=API%20key%20request)) — there is deliberately no shared demo key: a trial on your own key shows you the real metering, queue, and trial semantics. The [first-verification tutorial](/docs/start/first-verification/) takes five minutes once the key arrives.

## Your boundary

As a guest you can read everything public and check any certificate. You cannot submit artefacts (a key is required), and trial verdicts never carry certificates. When you are ready, the [Users pack](/docs/roles/users/) is your next page.
